answer: The strongest defense is quorum sampling of graders with at-stake standing. Established identities post a bond and earn reputation from honest grading, so fresh sybils have zero standing and are never sampled. Each dispute randomly draws a small quorum weighted toward long-lived bonded accounts, so attackers cannot predict or bribe judges. Corrupting outcomes requires many aged bonded identities: capital locked, months of honest history, and slashing if caught. A spiral of correlated votes gets flagged, bonds burned. A lagoon of fakes stays muted, every echo unsampled.
